- 本次给出：矩阵解法

## 另一种解法
Matrix solution. The field is not stated, so take it to be \(\mathbb R\).  
The set of vectors mapped to the zero vector is the solution set of \(A\vec{x}=\vec{0}\). Form the augmented matrix and row-reduce:

\[
\left[\begin{array}{cccc|c}
1 & 3 & 1 & 1 & 0\\
0 & 1 & 2 & -2 & 0\\
-1 & -2 & 1 & -3 & 0
\end{array}\right]
\]

Row operations:
- \(R_3 \leftarrow R_3 + R_1\):
\[
\left[\begin{array}{cccc|c}
1 & 3 & 1 & 1 & 0\\
0 & 1 & 2 & -2 & 0\\
0 & 1 & 2 & -2 & 0
\end{array}\right]
\]
- \(R_3 \leftarrow R_3 - R_2\):
\[
\left[\begin{array}{cccc|c}
1 & 3 & 1 & 1 & 0\\
0 & 1 & 2 & -2 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right]
\]
- \(R_1 \leftarrow R_1 - 3R_2\):
\[
\left[\begin{array}{cccc|c}
1 & 0 & -5 & 7 & 0\\
0 & 1 & 2 & -2 & 0\\
0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 0
\end{array}\right]
\]

Thus the equations are
\[
x_1 - 5x_3 + 7x_4 = 0,\qquad
x_2 + 2x_3 - 2x_4 = 0.
\]
So
\[
x_1 = 5x_3 - 7x_4,\qquad
x_2 = -2x_3 + 2x_4,
\]
with \(x_3,x_4\) free.

Taking \(x_4=1,\ x_3=0\) gives
\[
\vec{u} = \begin{bmatrix}
-7\\
2\\
0\\
1
\end{bmatrix}.
\]
Taking \(x_3=1,\ x_4=0\) gives
\[
\vec{v} = \begin{bmatrix}
5\\
-2\\
1\\
0
\end{bmatrix}.
\]
The row-reduced matrix has two pivot columns, so \(\operatorname{rank}(A)=2\). Hence the solution set has dimension \(4-2=2\). The two vectors above are linearly independent and therefore span the whole solution set.

## 步骤对应
- 已有解法中的 \(\ker(T)\) 对应本次矩阵解法中 \(A\vec{x}=\vec{0}\) 的解空间。
- 已有解法中解 \(T(x)=0\) 对应本次对增广矩阵 \([A \mid 0]\) 做行化简。
- 已有解法中第一个生成元由 \(x_4=1,\ x_3=0\) 得到，对应本次取 \((x_3,x_4)=(0,1)\)，得到 \(\vec{u}\)。
- 已有解法中第二个生成元由 \(x_3=1,\ x_4=0\) 得到，对应本次取 \((x_3,x_4)=(1,0)\)，得到 \(\vec{v}\)。
- 已有解法中 \(\ker(T)\) 是二维平面，对应本次 \(\operatorname{rank}(A)=2\)、零空间维数为 \(2\)，\(\vec{u},\vec{v}\) 张成整个解空间。

## 约定
- 自由变量为 \(x_3,x_4\)。
- 两个生成元的顺序与缩放：第一个由 \(x_4=1,\ x_3=0\) 得到；第二个由 \(x_3=1,\ x_4=0\) 得到；不交换、不缩放。
- 来源：继承已有解法

## 答案
\[
\vec{u}=\begin{bmatrix}-7\\2\\0\\1\end{bmatrix},\qquad
\vec{v}=\begin{bmatrix}5\\-2\\1\\0\end{bmatrix}.
\]

## 可核对结论
- 类型：基
- 结论： -7 | 2 | 0 | 1 | 5 | -2 | 1 | 0
- 约定：自由变量 \(x_3,x_4\)；\(\vec{u}\) 来自 \((x_3,x_4)=(0,1)\)，\(\vec{v}\) 来自 \((x_3,x_4)=(1,0)\)，不缩放
- 约定来源：继承已有解法

## 检验
\[
A\vec{u}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & 3 & 1 & 1\\
0 & 1 & 2 & -2\\
-1 & -2 & 1 & -3
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
-7\\2\\0\\1
\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
0\\0\\0
\end{bmatrix}.
\]
\[
A\vec{v}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
1 & 3 & 1 & 1\\
0 & 1 & 2 & -2\\
-1 & -2 & 1 & -3
\end{bmatrix}
\begin{bmatrix}
5\\-2\\1\\0
\end{bmatrix}
=
\begin{bmatrix}
0\\0\\0
\end{bmatrix}.
\]
The row-reduced form has two nonzero rows, so \(\operatorname{rank}(A)=2\), and the nullspace has dimension \(4-2=2\). Thus \(\vec{u},\vec{v}\) span the entire solution set. The inherited values are consistent with the row reduction.

【题目】
Let A=\left[\begin{array}{cccc} 1 &3 &1 &1\cr 0 &1 &2 &-2\cr-1 &-2 &1 &-3 \end{array}\right]. Find a pair of vectors $\vec{u}, \vec{v}$ in ${\mathbb R}^4$ that span the set of all $\vec{x}\in {\mathbb R}^4$ that are mapped into the zero vector by the transformation $\vec{x} \mapsto A\vec{x}$.
$\vec{u}=$ \begin {array}{c} [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \end{array}, $\vec{v}=$ \begin {array}{c} [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \end{array}.

In the section 可核对结论, the line starting with 结论 must contain only the [ANS] values in order, separated by ' | '. Do not add words on that line.

【已有解法类型】
线性空间解法

【必须给出】
矩阵解法

【翻译规则】
这是翻译，不是重新选题。沿用已有解法里合法的不唯一选择，不要改成你自己更习惯的取法。
若其中有计算错误，可核对结论写改正后的结果；约定仍沿用说得通的原取法，并在检验中指出错误。

【已有解法】
Linear-space solution.
Let T: R^4 -> R^3, T(x)=Ax. The set of vectors sent to zero is ker(T).
Solving T(x)=0 produces the plane
ker(T) = span{ (-7,2,0,1), (5,-2,1,0) }.
The first generator is the vector in which the free coordinate x4 equals 1 and x3 equals 0. The second is the vector in which x3 equals 1 and x4 equals 0.
Convention locked by this solution: keep this order. Do not swap the two generators and do not rescale them.
Checkable values: -7, 2, 0, 1, 5, -2, 1, 0.
